messages:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — uploaded a new dark-mode comp for the Metrics dashboard charts. Focus: legend readability, series colors, and inline code syntax in the details panel. https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx (link). Please keep a11y in mind.

Liam O'Neill: Looks good overall. 2 quick nits: the orange series (#ff8a3d) vs the red series (#ff5a5a) are only ~2.9:1 contrast on the dark bg. Need >=4.5:1 for small legend text. Also color-blind folks will confuse those two.

Sasha Patel: Agreed on the strings. Also the inline code block in the details panel is almost the same saturation as the background — loses token separation. Proposing subtle shell of code bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.03) and bump string token to #ffd47a.

Tom Reyes: Chart UX: Can we increase line weights for thin series to 1.5px and add a 2px hitbox for hover? Keyboard focus needs a 2px high-contrast ring for the legend items (not just hover). ARIA: legend items should have role="button" + aria-pressed for toggle state.

Liam O'Neill: Quick palette idea (color-blind safe + contrast):
```css
:root {
  --series-blue: #4ea8ff; /* 6.8:1 */
  --series-orange: #ffb36b; /* 5.1:1 vs bg */
  --series-magenta: #d46fff; /* distinct for screen readers */
  --legend-text: #e6eef8; /* 7:1 */
}
```
Feel free to tweak values, but aim for >=4.5:1 for legible legend text.

ContrastBot: Automated contrast audit results: legend-text vs bg #0b0f13 => 7.2:1 (PASS). orange(#ff8a3d) vs bg => 2.9:1 (FAIL). proposed orange (#ffb36b) vs bg => 5.1:1 (PASS). Keyboard focus ring default: fails.

Sasha Patel: For syntax highlight tokens in details panel, propose mapping: keyword #9be6ff, function name #c7f9d6, string #ffd47a, number #ffb36b. Also add diff between inline `code` and block ```code``` backgrounds: inline = rgba(255,255,255,0.03), block = rgba(255,255,255,0.05) with 8px padding.

Maya Chen: Love the palette. Liam/Sasha — can one of you drop the new tokens into the theme tokens JSON? I'll push a quick PR and run integration tests on staging charts.

Liam O'Neill: On it — will add tokens and regenerate the chart legend preview. ETA 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Tom Reyes: Also logging a tiny copy tweak: legend toggle tooltip should read "Toggle series visibility" (currently "Toggle"). Accessibility and clarity.

Maya Chen: Good catch — updating copy in the PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ContrastBot: Follow-up after token update (automated): all series colors pass contrast threshold and legend text passes. Keyboard focus ring still flagged — suggest 2px #ffffff33 outline on dark bg.

Maya Chen: Will add the focus ring rule and a11y notes in the PR description. Planning to ship as a patch release to prod next week after QA.

Liam O'Neill: Quick note: add a small legend hover state (background #ffffff05) to improve discoverability on touch.

Sasha Patel: Done — updated the Figma component. Leaving a comment on the node with token names.

Maya Chen: Thanks — will loop in QA and rel-note the copy change. Closing thread once PR is green.
